source.note: Search summary: 101 km of slopes and 23 lifts in the Grindelwald-Wengen (Kleine Scheidegg/Männlichen) area. The whole Jungfrau Ski Region has about 210–211 km across three areas (Grindelwald-Wengen, Grindelwald-First, Mürren-Schilthorn). Lift types, capacity and difficulty split not found.
Piste reference data — confirm at source. Ski schools and rental shops operate in Grindelwald and Wengen; other features not on file

character: Skiing between Grindelwald and car-free Wengen beneath the Eiger, Mönch and Jungfrau, centred on Kleine Scheidegg and Männlichen; the Lauberhorn World Cup downhill is raced above Wengen (reference). The Eiger Express gondola links Grindelwald Terminal with the Eigergletscher station (reference).
learning: Reference note: ski schools in Grindelwald and Wengen. Confirm beginner areas and lesson products.
